response.reasoning: The brief explicitly requests a 5 kW rooftop solar PV array integrated into the roof structure. Solar panels and rooftop PV systems are deferred to Slice 2B.3 v2 and are not supported in v1. The extension Slice 2B.3 v1 catalog does not include solar as a standard extension option.
response.refusal_reason: Rooftop solar PV arrays are deferred to v2. Slice 2B.3 v1 does not yet support solar panel integration or rooftop photovoltaic systems.
